title: IT Project Manager
summary: An IT project manager plans and runs technology projects such as system rollouts, upgrades and migrations, making sure they finish on time, within budget and to the agreed scope. You sit between business owners, the technical team and outside vendors, and report progress to sponsors or a PMO (project management office).
dailyDuties: Build and update project plans, milestones and schedules
Run status meetings and send weekly status reports
Track risks, issues and dependencies and escalate blockers
Track budget and spend against forecast
Manage vendor deliverables against the statement of work
Handle change requests to scope, cost or timeline
Prepare go-live readiness and project closure reports

skills.expectation: Plan scope, schedule and milestones for IT projects and drive them to closure
Run projects in waterfall, agile or hybrid ways as the work needs
Track risks, issues and dependencies in a RAID log and escalate early
Track the project budget, forecast spend and explain variances
Manage vendors and partners against the SOW and contract
Keep business owners and sponsors aligned and run steering meetings
Write clear status reports and run project meetings
Lead a cross-functional team of internal staff and contractors
Track tasks and defects in Jira or Azure DevOps
Help shape requirements and sign-off with business analysts
Plan user acceptance testing and go-live readiness
Hand projects over to operations through ITIL change and release
Work inside SAFe release trains on large programmes
Build trackers, plans and budget sheets in Excel
Build project dashboards for the PMO

certifications.why: The certification most often named in India IT project manager postings
Shows agile delivery basics for hybrid projects
An entry step before PMP for newer project managers.
Named alongside PMP in some Indian postings, especially for UK clients.
Useful for project managers who run IT service transitions.
